_comment: Lattice 3-plane profile. Three orthogonal dimensions: wire (traffic), operational (behavior), opsec (evasion).

wire_plane._comment: Controls what the traffic looks like on the wire. Changing this alone does not change agent behavior or evasion posture.
wire_plane._ja4_note: null = use platform default (WinHTTP/Schannel fingerprint). Set to a target JA4 hash to configure TLS params accordingly — requires custom TLS stack.

operational_plane._comment: Controls agent behavior independent of wire format. These settings affect what the agent does, not how traffic looks.
operational_plane._fork_and_run_note: false = in-process BOF execution (lower footprint, no child process). true = spawn sacrificial process (more resilient to BOF crashes).

opsec_plane._comment: Controls which evasion layers are active. OTA hot-swappable via TASK_PROFILE_HOT without cycling the implant.

sleep_mask._type_note: Options: plain | timer_queue_apc | fiber. plain = no masking (lab use).
sleep_mask._encrypt_heap_note: XOR-encrypt heap allocations before sleep. Defeats Moneta heap scan.

call_gate._call_gate_note: When enabled, all WinAPI calls are proxied through gate_dll to normalize call-stack origin. See research-report-lattice-architecture-ideas.md §call-gate.

opsec_plane._etwti_note: Options: none | indirect_syscall | hardware_breakpoint. hardware_breakpoint is detectable via Kernel-Audit-API-Calls ETW. none recommended for lab.
opsec_plane._cfg_note: When enabled, inserts ROP gadgets from known DLLs into the call stack before sensitive calls. Breaks Elastic call_stack_contains_unbacked == true signature.
opsec_plane._amsi_note: Options: none | in_process. in_process patches AmsiScanBuffer; detectable via Kernel-Audit-API-Calls. Avoid in production.
